caption:
🔘 TechCrunch Disrupt 2024: dunyodagi eng yirik konferensiyalardan birida o‘z startapingiz yoki IT-kompaniyangizni namoyish eting!

“Silkroad Innovation Hub” IT Park va “Astana Hub” bilan birgalikda yana bir bor Markaziy Yevroosiyo startaplarini dunyodagi eng yirik texno-konferensiyalardan biri — “TechCrunch Disrupt 2024” tadbirida taqdim etadi!

📝 Har bir jamoaga startap xiyobonida o‘z loyihasini namoyish etish, investorlar bilan yangi aloqalar o‘rnatish va mutaxassislardan fikr-mulohaza olish uchun alohida stend taqdim etiladi. Shuningdek, ishtirokchilar o‘z loyihalarini sahnalarning birida investorlar, korporatsiyalar va “TechCrunch Disrupt” qatnashchilariga taqdim etish imkoniyatiga ega bo‘ladilar.

🔵 Mahsulotingiz haqida so‘zlab, e’tibor va moliyaviy qo‘llab-quvvatlashni jalb qilish imkoniyatini boy bermang!

➡️ Quyidagi havola orqali ariza topshirib, “TechCrunch Disrupt 2024” ishtirokchisiga aylaning:
https://tc24.slkrd.io

Sana: 2024-yil 28-30-oktyabr
O‘tkazilish joyi: Moscone Center, San-Fransisko, Kaliforniya
____________

🔘 TechCrunch Disrupt 2024: Showcase Your Startup or IT Company at One of the World’s Largest Conferences!

Silkroad Innovation Hub, in collaboration with IT Park and Astana Hub, will once again represent startups from Central Eurasia at one of the world’s major tech conferences — TechCrunch Disrupt 2024!

📝 Each team will be provided with a dedicated booth on the Startup Alley to showcase their project, engage with investors, and receive feedback from experts. Additionally, participants will have the opportunity to pitch their projects to investors, corporations, and TechCrunch Disrupt attendees on one of the main stages.

🔵 Don’t miss this opportunity to highlight your product and attract attention and secure funding!

➡️ To participate in TechCrunch Disrupt 2024, submit your application here: https://tc24.slkrd.io

Date: October 28-30, 2024 
Venue: Moscone Center, San Francisco, California
